# Frontend UI libraries

- `liquid-glass.umd.js` — `@real-human/liquid-glass` 1.2.0, MIT. Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@real-human/liquid-glass
- `scroll.umd.js` and `scrolljs.css` — `@charmingdc/scrolljs` 2.0.1, MIT. Source: https://github.com/Charmingdc/ScrollJs

Both files are vendored locally so the interface does not depend on a runtime CDN request.
